section: what minimax is: one running experiment on attention
text: What MiniMax is: one running experiment on attention MiniMax is a Shanghai lab (founded December 2021, Wikipedia ) whose model line is defined by one running experiment: how far the quadratic softmax attention of a standard transformer can be replaced by something cheaper without losing frontier quality.
label: core

section: what minimax is: one running experiment on attention

section: the bill being attacked
text: The bill being attacked Softmax attention for one head computes, over a sequence of n tokens, softmax ( Q K ⊤ d ) V Q, K, V the n × d matrices of queries, keys and values for one head d the head dimension The softmax sits between the two matrix products, so the n × n score matrix must be formed: prefill costs on the order of n 2 d per head, and every decoded token must read the keys and values of every earlier token, which are kept in the KV cache .

section: lightning attention (minimax-01, m1): linear attention computed in blocks
text: Causal linear attention looks cheap, but computed token by token it is a cumulative sum along the sequence, which serialises the very dimension a GPU wants to parallelise.
label: core

section: lightning attention (minimax-01, m1): linear attention computed in blocks
text: Lightning attention cuts the sequence into blocks of B tokens and splits each block's output in two: inside the block, the ordinary masked quadratic product (small and fully parallel, the report's "left product"); from all earlier blocks, one multiplication by the carried state (the "right product").
label: core

section: lightning attention (minimax-01, m1): linear attention computed in blocks
text: For block i : O i = [ ( Q i K i ⊤ ) ⊙ M ] V i + Q i S i − 1 , S i = S i − 1 + K i ⊤ V i Q i , K i , V i the queries, keys and values of the B tokens in block i , each B × d M the B × B causal mask (1 where the key is at or before the query, 0 elsewhere); ⊙ is elementwise multiplication, so the first term is the intra-block part S i−1 the d × d state summing k j ⊤ v j over every token in blocks 1 to i − 1, so the second term is the inter-block part; the second equation carries the state on The cost per head is O ( n d 2 + n B d ) where nd 2 is the state updates and reads and nBd the intra-block products: linear in n for a fixed block size.
label: core

section: lightning attention (minimax-01, m1): linear attention computed in blocks

text: RL for LLMs owns PPO and GRPO; the one fact needed here is that both maximise, per token, min ( r A ^ , clip ( r , 1 − ε , 1 + ε ) A ^ ) r the ratio of the new to the old policy's probability of that token Â its advantage ε the clip range When Â > 0 and r > 1 + ε , the clipped branch is the minimum and it does not depend on the parameters, so the token's gradient is exactly zero (and symmetrically for Â < 0 and r < 1 − ε ).

section: cispo: the rl objective from m1

section: cispo: the rl objective from m1

section: common mistakes and misconceptions
text: The maths, and the recall limit, are linear attention's. "MiniMax-01 has no KV cache." Its 10 softmax layers do: 40 KiB per token.
label: depth

section: common mistakes and misconceptions
text: Only the 70 lightning layers replace the cache with a fixed state. "M2 went back to full attention because linear attention is slow." The stated reasons are quality on multi-hop reasoning and retrieval-style circuits, an evaluation gap that hid it, and immature infrastructure; speed was the attraction, not the problem. "MSA shrinks the KV cache." It shrinks what each query reads.
label: depth

section: common mistakes and misconceptions
text: The whole cache stays resident so the indexer can choose from it, plus its own index keys; M3's smaller cache comes from 4 key/value heads instead of 8. "MSA's selection is finer than DSA's." DSA selects individual tokens; MSA selects 128-token blocks, separately per GQA group.
label: depth

section: common mistakes and misconceptions
text: MSA is finer than MoBA, not than DSA. "CISPO just widens the clip." It moves the clip from the update to the weight and stops the weight's gradient, so no token's gradient is ever zeroed; a wider PPO clip still silences tokens past it. "The 4M-token context was trained." Training reached 1M; 4M is inference extrapolation. "M3 has 22B active parameters." The model card says about 23B, and the config rebuilds to 23.5B. "Full attention scales exponentially with context." Quadratically: prefill grows with n 2 and each decoded token's reads with n .
label: depth

section: common mistakes and misconceptions
text: The phrase appears in launch coverage ( Fireworks ). "MiniMax's apps pay for its models." The apps provide two-thirds of revenue, but 2025 revenue of $79.0 million was under a third of R&D spending; the models are funded by investors and the listing.
label: depth
